title: Add Packing List shortcut on Travel Style Quiz results page

requirements.text: On the Travel Style Quiz results screen (the view that shows the heading “Your Travel Style Revealed!” after the quiz is completed), add a prominent call-to-action shortcut that navigates the user to the existing Packing List page route (#packing-list). The shortcut’s visible label must be in English (e.g., “Personalize your packing list here”).

quotes: Als de travel style quiz gemaakt is wil ik dat in de Your Travel Style Revealed! pagina een short cut komt naar Onze packing lists "personaliseer hier je paklijst"
Ja die mag linken naar onze Traveltools > Packing list

acceptanceCriteria: After completing the Travel Style Quiz and reaching the “Your Travel Style Revealed!” results view, a visible shortcut/CTA is rendered on that page.
Clicking/tapping the shortcut navigates using the app’s existing hash routing to #packing-list and renders the PackingList page.
The shortcut is not shown during the quiz questions flow (only on the completed/results view).
No new pages are created; the existing PackingList route in App.tsx is used.

constraints: Frontend routing must use the existing hash-based navigation pattern (e.g., window.location.hash = '#packing-list' or an equivalent existing navigation approach).
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change the quiz scoring, archetype logic, or any existing result content beyond adding the new shortcut.
Do not add or change backend (Motoko) functionality for this request.
Do not create a new Packing List feature/page; reuse the existing PackingList page/route.
